points.missing: No taxonomy code covers a summarization step that correctly identifies key entities in its own reasoning but omits them from the passed-forward summary, thereby depriving a later retrieval step of the specific entity names needed to target evidence; this is a content-fidelity loss in summarization rather than a misreading (SP_02), an external-knowledge insertion (SP_01), a query-construction fault (SP_05/06/07), or an unlicensed conclusion (SP_15).
